actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Another uploader’s media can be attached and read
actions_or_findings.trigger: A resident submits a guessed, uploaded file_id belonging to another user in the same tenant and property when creating their own work order.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The attachment check accepts a non-uploader when the property matches. The new download path then treats that attachment as an authorized relation, allowing the resident to read the other user’s bytes. The same tenant condition does not prevent this anti-IDOR bypass.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Missing stored bytes permit replacement of committed media
actions_or_findings.trigger: An object disappears after its first upload, then its uploader retries with different valid bytes of the declared size and MIME.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The missing-object branch writes the retry and replaces the committed content hash without comparing it with the prior hash. An already attached file can therefore change instead of returning FILE.CONFLICT or a storage failure. The normal-object immutability evidence does not cover this case.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Process cache masks missing or corrupted persistent objects
actions_or_findings.trigger: The configured disk object is removed or corrupted while its original bytes remain in _DEV_OBJECTS.
actions_or_findings.rationale: get_object returns cached bytes before checking the persistent file. Read and attachment integrity checks can pass for an object that will fail after process replacement, contrary to the missing-or-corrupted attachment requirement.

actions_or_findings.title: RELEASE_BLOCKER: Selected PNG or WebP images are declared as JPEG
actions_or_findings.trigger: The image picker supplies PNG or WebP bytes.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The page registers every chosen image as image/jpeg with a .jpg name. The new MIME-magic validation correctly rejects those bytes, so the native image upload path needs format detection before V1 delivery.

actions_or_findings.title: RELEASE_BLOCKER: Production media has no scan finalization
actions_or_findings.rationale: Registration leaves scanner_status pending, while attachment and download require clean or skipped_dev. No scanner/finalize path is present. Production object storage and private delivery remain outside this approved Development slice.
